synth.notes:
Model: single wall axis row A (3x3 blocks), pieces as block sets, targets as solid block sets; each piece block off the axis reflects to (2A-r,c), clipped, skipped on piece blocks.
A1/A2 move selected axis/piece one block row; A3/A4 move a piece one column; pieces blocked by bounds/other pieces only (axis passes under pieces).
Missed mechanic at step 64: A5 cycle is axis -> pieces LARGEST FIRST (block count desc, tie min block) -> axis, not bbox order; from the 7-block L it goes to the 6-block T. Ablating to bbox order reproduces the committee failure exactly.
Render: layered composite piece>reflection>target>wall (first solid, else topmost hole fill>=0), re-extract by colour; wall/piece names rank comps of own+all 0 cells (0-only comps count, explains wall_h_6/7 and piece_21).
Passes 33/33 with hidden state disabled too; hidden state only carries the parsed model on continuity. Unconfirmed: cycle order with 3+ pieces or equal sizes.
